description: This file defines the IFieldCodecProvider interface, which provides methods to access codecs for serialization of different field types within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: IFieldCodecProvider
classes.description: Interface that defines methods to obtain codecs for specific field types, both generic and Type-based.

methods.name: GetCodec<TField>
methods.description: Retrieves a codec for the specified field type TField.

methods.name: TryGetCodec<TField>
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a codec for the specified field type TField, returning null if not found.

methods.name: GetCodec(Type fieldType)
methods.description: Retrieves a codec for the specified field type at runtime using a Type object.

methods.name: TryGetCodec(Type fieldType)
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a codec for the specified runtime Type, returning null if not found.
